scope.description: Distinct nonempty safe-read request contexts under a static two-voter configuration and unchanged leader term; original request completes before fresh invocation.
assumptions: Fresh caller context bytes uniquely identify the later invocation.
The retained reply is an exact duplicate of an actual earlier follower heartbeat response.
No lease-based read mode, singleton shortcut, membership transition or crash.
excluded: Same-context retry and version-qualified release-3.7 applicability.
Client state-machine return and global linearizability history.
Eventual completion under indefinitely missing quorum.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes or internal state assignment.
MemoryStorage provides deterministic caller storage completion; no disk durability or client application value is measured.
Exact duplicate old heartbeat response is injected through RawNode.Step while fresh network work is finitely delayed.

plan_uncertainties: No client-return or physical application value is observed.
Scope excludes context reuse, leader change, singleton and lease-based reads.
The shared bootstrap prefix is constructed through public storage initialization; elections and reply producers are executed.
grounding_unresolved: A bounded public-API replay schedule must still execute.
This does not observe a client state-machine read or whole-system linearizability.
Only one old-context replay and one new request are measured; same-context reuse, term transitions and joint configuration remain unmeasured.
